g.text: ● accepted ○ rejected □ ran a read-position diagnostic (5 runs)
4 of 24 runs accepted. GPT-5.6 Sol in Galaxy ran the diagnostic as a UDT in
replicates 2 and 3, and both were accepted; 3 custom-code runs also ran it (1 accepted).
